descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-11 AI Check; UAT 3.2 · “Complete a note that doesn't mention any procedure. Confirm the new timeline entry doesn't state a procedure occurred.”.

Decision D3 · S0 · Preston

Two Course Timeline AI-check answers are borderline; the grading rules need calibrating first

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-11/S14

Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S13 AI Check: a note with no procedure gives an entry with no procedure — Hospital (5 of the 10)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 AI Check: after completing a note that mentions no procedure, the new timeline entry does not state that a procedure occurred. … (UAT TC-11 AI Check; UAT 3.2; TFA-92589 AC 6)
  • U10 Never invent: an entry contains nothing that is not in the completed note (no supplied diagnosis, finding, procedure or event). (UAT 3.4; TFA-92589 AC 6)
  • U8 Run in both modes for one patient each: Hospital across 2 consecutive days, Nursing Home across 3+ visits. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Five finished Hospital notes, none of which mentions a procedure, each on a diagnosis that tempts one (GI bleed → EGD, NSTEMI → cath, effusion → thoracentesis, urosepsis → line/Foley, SBO → NG tube/surgery). H-05 is sparse ('OBJECTIVE: Not dictated.'), as undictated sections read under 3.4

When Each note goes through ai/notes:refreshCourseAndBackground with the args the Hospital client sends: courseTimeline ends with today's pending pre-round line, as useNoteGeneration.ts sends existingSummary.course before the flip; then the client's scrubCourseEntry + withCourseDate

Then Every stored entry is non-empty and names no procedure, diagnosis, finding or number that is absent from the note, and does not narrate documentation status

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per fixture: nonEmpty; mustNotInclude (case-insensitive substring) and mustNotIncludeWord (whole word, for short abbreviations such as LHC, NGT, PRBC); numbersFromSource (every number in the scrubbed entry, before withCourseDate adds the date, appears in noteText or courseTimeline); then the judge layer below. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Preston; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to failed.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Preston) · environment local · tickets TFA-92589 ready for qa

No Hospital course entry named a procedure, but two entries need a person to rule: one restates the chart's diagnosis 'Upper GI bleed with melena resolved', and one carries 'continuing bowel rest' from an earlier line. Until then the 9/10 AI-check bar cannot be called.

Evidence: allure 418e1fc4. The deterministic layer passes 10/10. In the uncalibrated judge, H-01 fails U1/U2 on the chart diagnosis (GK8: does the diagnosis on file count as a source?), and the judges disagree on H-05. Across S13 and S14: 5 pass, 2 judge fails, 3 need a person, so at most 8/10 if H-01 is a fail. Preston rules on GK8 and the calibration. The generateNote layer was held back as unauthorised on local and needs Quinn's OK.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
